entries.known: WT wiki: ricochets are 'likely' above ~70 deg; APC/APCBC fare slightly better.
entries.unknown: Whether 65-75 deg is a hard threshold or a probability ramp, and per-shell-type offsets.

entries.known: Above this angle ricochet is treated as certain.
WT wiki HE mechanics: fragments spray in a cone of roughly 30-45 deg aligned with the residual projectile direction.
entries.unknown: Exact cone angle per shell class; fragment count and mass distribution formulas are not public.

entries.known: Per-shell K coefficients and global exponents are datamined; the absolute normalization constant of the formula is not published.
entries.unknown: The absolute constant; calibrated against WT stat-card penetration points.
